descriptor.scene: The shop busy, with the whole street queuing for a plane. THE CAMERA IS INSIDE THE SHED looking toward the open doorway at the LEFT, where a line of children waits outside on the grass in the sunshine. EVERY CHILD WHO IS INDOORS STANDS ON THE SHED FLOOR ON THE NEAR SIDE OF THE WORKBENCH, between the bench and the camera, with their feet on the floorboards. Mira stands at the near side of the bench with her notebook and pencil, taking an order. Tomas stands beside her handing a finished plane down to Bea, who is small and reaching up for it in her plum cardigan and green wellington boots. Ana, tall with black braids and round glasses, and Sam, curly ginger in a green-and-cream striped tee, wait their turn just inside the doorway, also standing on the floor. THE FINISHED PLANES ON THE BENCH ARE THE SUBJECT AND NO TWO ARE ALIKE: one folded to read as a CAT with two pointed ears at the nose, one folded from PRINTED NEWSPAPER with type visible, one with a clean ROUND HOLE through its wing, one soft blue, one muted yellow, one long and thin, one broad and square. A few more are already up in the air near the ceiling. Cheerful, busy and slightly chaotic. Every person in frame is a child. CRITICAL ON THE FURNITURE, because two previous renders broke here. There is EXACTLY ONE WORKBENCH and it is ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS SURFACE built against the right-hand wall: one unbroken top, one straight unbroken front edge running clean across the frame, everything on it in the same perspective. There is NO SECOND TABLE, NO second desk, NO extra bench, NO counter at another angle, and no surface that folds, steps, changes plane or stops partway. AND NO CHILD IS EVER INSIDE, BEHIND, OR PASSING THROUGH THE BENCH. The bench is against the wall so THERE IS NO FLOOR ON ITS FAR SIDE and nobody can stand there. No child's body may be intersected, bisected or occluded by the bench top, no torso may emerge from the bench surface, and no legs may appear on the far side of it. Every child is a WHOLE FIGURE standing on the floor in front of the bench or out in the doorway. If any child appears to grow out of the workbench the image has failed. THERE IS NO ROBOT, NO MECHANICAL FIGURE, NO TOY ROBOT and NO TIN FIGURE anywhere in this image.
